claim: § The trick: a metaball "seen off-axis looks like a ball", while a camera-facing card keeps the mark flat and gives it parallax — "flatness and parallax at once. That choice is the whole idea." A claim about motion the text can only describe.

pieces.what: Orbit a single ink mark made two ways, as a metaball and as a camera-facing card, so the reader sees which stays ink
pieces.walks_up_from: one ink blob on a card
